items.title: Weather alert: Winter Weather Advisory, 11 a.m. Thu., Nov. 19 to 5 a.m. Sat., Nov. 21
items.summary: The National Weather Service has a new Winter Weather Advisory for the Wasatch Back from 11 a.m. Thursday to 5 a.m. Saturday. It calls for 2 to 7 inches of snow, with the higher totals in the higher terrain near Park City and the Ogden Valley. The Weather Service says the snow will affect the Thursday evening and Friday morning commutes. The Eden-area forecast has rain and snow Thursday (83% chance), high near 41°, then snow Thursday night and Friday (93 to 96% chance), with a low near 20° Friday night. Slow down in the canyon and on mountain roads. Forecasts change; we'll update.
items.source: National Weather Service Salt Lake City: Winter Weather Advisory issued 3:49 p.m. MST Nov. 18, 2026; Eden-area and Huntsville forecasts updated 3:52 p.m. MST Nov. 18, 2026
items.alt: Weather alert from Ben's Weather Desk: Winter Weather Advisory 11 a.m. Thursday to 5 a.m. Saturday. Ben the moose shoveling snow. 2 to 7 inches for the Wasatch Back; in Huntsville 1 to 2 inches Thursday night, 2 to 4 Friday, 1 to 2 Friday night. Five-day forecast Thursday to Monday.

items.title: Weather alert: Winter Weather Advisory until 11 a.m. Wed., Nov. 18
items.summary: The National Weather Service has a Winter Weather Advisory for the Wasatch Back until 11 a.m. Wednesday, with 1 to 4 inches expected and the most in Park City and the Ogden Valley. In Huntsville, rain until about 2 p.m. turns to a rain and snow mix, then snow this evening: up to an inch today and 1 to 2 more tonight, low near 22°. Wednesday is mostly sunny, near 41°. A bigger storm follows: rain and snow Thursday, then snow Friday, 4 to 6 inches, and 3 to 5 more Friday night, with a low near 18°. Slow down in the canyon and on mountain roads, and bring pets in tonight. Forecasts change; we'll update.
items.alt: Weather alert from Ben's Weather Desk: Winter Weather Advisory until 11 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 18. Ben the moose in earmuffs and a scarf holding a snow shovel. Rain now, snow by this evening; 1 to 4 inches for the Wasatch Back; bigger snow Friday, 4 to 6 inches, then 3 to 5 Friday night. Five-day forecast Wednesday to Sunday.
items.source: National Weather Service Salt Lake City: Winter Weather Advisory issued 10:05 a.m. MST Nov. 17, 2026; Huntsville forecast issued 11:31 a.m. MST Nov. 17, 2026

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: week of Nov. 16
items.summary: A colder, snowier week for Eden, Liberty and Huntsville. Monday is dry, near 57°, low 31°. Tuesday brings a rain and snow mix (93% chance), high 49°, low 24°. Then snow chances: Wednesday 25%, high 43°, low 23°; Thursday 87%, high 42°, low 22°; Friday 66%, high 40°, low 19°. Forecast as of Nov. 14; forecasts change, and updates go up here when they do.
items.alt: Ben's Weather Desk, week of Nov. 16: Ben the moose at the news desk, with the forecast below: Monday 57 and dry, Tuesday 49 with a 93% rain and snow mix, Wednesday 43 with 25% snow, Thursday 42 with 87% snow, Friday 40 with 66% snow.
items.source: National Weather Service forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, as of Nov. 14, 2026

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: week of Nov. 9
items.summary: A dry, mild week is forecast for Eden, Liberty and Huntsville. Highs of 59–63°, sunny to partly sunny all week. Lows of 33–36°, with Tuesday and Wednesday nights dropping to about 33°, near freezing. No rain or snow is forecast Monday through Saturday. Next weekend, a cooler, wetter turn is possible. On the colder nights, disconnect garden hoses and cover tender plants. It's a good week to finish fall yard work and get snow tires and winter gear ready.
items.alt: Ben's Weather Desk, week of Nov. 9: Ben the moose at the news desk, with the 7-day forecast below: dry Monday through Thursday, highs 58 to 63, lows 33 to 36, a small rain chance Friday and Saturday and 36% Sunday.
items.source: National Weather Service forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 11:31 a.m. MST Nov. 8, 2026

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: Nov. 6 to 11
items.summary: A dry, sunny week: sunny to mostly sunny every day through Thursday, highs of 53–62°, no rain or snow in the forecast and calm wind. Frosty mornings with lows of 31–36°, coldest Friday night near 31°, so leave time to scrape the windshield. One lane of SR-39 in upper Ogden Canyon stays closed through April, with flaggers by day and a signal at night. Veterans Day, Wednesday, Nov. 11: sunny, high near 61°. A good week to finish yard cleanup, blow out sprinklers and put hoses away.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather briefing for Nov. 6 to 11: a six-day forecast, all sunny and dry, plus boxes on a dry sunny week, frosty mornings, the Ogden Canyon lane closure, Veterans Day, and a good-week-to list.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 11:31 a.m. Nov. 6, 2026; UDOT Traffic (SR-39)

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: Nov. 1 to 6
items.summary: A soaking Sunday: rain turning to showers and thunderstorms (100%), with about three-quarters of an inch to an inch of rain possible and a high near 50°. A chance of light rain Monday through Wednesday (36–44%), then drier and sunnier by Thursday. Lows of 29–32° Monday through Friday nights, so cover tender plants and unhook hoses. Snow level near 6,600 feet, so the peaks may turn white while the Valley floor stays rain. Starting as early as Monday, Nov. 2, and through April, one lane of SR-39 in upper Ogden Canyon is closed, with alternating traffic around the clock. Air quality is Good.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather briefing for Nov. 1 to 6: a six-day forecast with Sunday highlighted at 100 percent, plus boxes on a soaking Sunday, frosty nights, snow up high, the Ogden Canyon lane closure, and a get-ready list.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 12:31 a.m. Nov. 1, 2026; UDOT Traffic (SR-39); Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 7:32 p.m. Oct. 31

items.title: Ogden Valley weather: Oct. 29 to Nov. 4
items.summary: Dry and mild today and early Friday, highs near 61°. Rain chances start Friday afternoon and evening (52%). Halloween looks wet: light rain Saturday turning to showers and thunderstorms by evening (99%), highs near 58°, so plan trick-or-treating with rain gear. Sunday, Nov. 1, brings showers and thunderstorms, then rain and snow likely Sunday night, with a chance of rain and snow Monday morning; lows near 29–31°. Snow level near 8,000 feet. Mostly sunny Tuesday and Wednesday, highs in the 50s. Air quality is Good. Clocks fall back one hour early Sunday, Nov. 1.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather briefing for Oct. 29 to Nov. 4: a six-day forecast with Saturday and Sunday highlighted at 99 percent, plus boxes on a wet Halloween, rain and snow Sunday night, clocks falling back, and drying out, and a get-ready list.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 12:31 a.m. Oct. 29, 2026; Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 3:31 p.m. Oct. 28

items.title: Ogden Valley weather update: Oct. 13–18
items.summary: Showers and thunderstorms tonight and Tuesday (94% chance Tuesday), with the snow level near 7,300 feet so the high peaks may turn white while the Valley floor stays rain. Lows of 29–32° every night through Friday, so cover tender plants and unhook hoses. Dry and sunny Thursday through Sunday, warming to the mid-60s. Air quality is Good.
items.alt: Ogden Valley weather update for Oct. 13 to 18: a six-day forecast with Tuesday wet at 94 percent, then sunny Thursday through Sunday, plus boxes on showers and thunder, frost nights, snow up high, a sunny weekend, and a get-ready checklist.
items.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 10:01 p.m. Oct. 12, 2026; Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 6:27 p.m. Oct. 12

items.title: Ogden Valley storm briefing: Oct. 9–14
items.summary: Leftovers of Tropical Storm Rachel. Wettest day Sunday, Oct. 11, with 1 to 3 inches of rain late Saturday to Monday morning, creeks running fast by Sunday evening, and snow levels dropping to 8,500–9,000 feet Monday to Wednesday.
items.alt: Ogden Valley storm briefing for Oct. 9 to 14: a six-day forecast with Sunday the wettest day, plus boxes on heavy rain, creeks and roads, wind, snow up high, and a get-ready checklist.
items.source: National Weather Service Salt Lake City forecast discussion, issued 2:55 p.m. Oct. 8, 2026; KSL and KUTV, Oct. 8
